truth: The paired Runtime/CSM build and transactional receipt migration completed on retained EBS. Ollama then stopped an actively loading 4.58 GiB Q4 model at its default five-minute stall timeout. The server now receives OLLAMA_LOAD_TIMEOUT=15m while KEEP_ALIVE remains infinite. Compute and stack cleanup completed, fallback did not run, and a new snapshot was created from the refreshed detached Runtime volume for reuse.
